    General tips

    How I play Camille

    Short, clean trades in lane, then push and roam to put pressure on the whole map.

    01

    Trading pattern

    • Into most champions: Q a minion, use the move speed to W the enemy, then Q2 auto for the true damage and leave.
    • Play around your passive. Trade when the shield is ready and back off while it's on cooldown. Since 26.16 it's smaller early but back every 14s, so look for more short trades rather than long ones.
    • Passive timing trick: E in just before your passive is back up. It comes off cooldown while they're stunned, so the shield is fresh for when they hit back instead of being wasted.
    • Land the W edge. The outer cone slows and heals you; the center doesn't.
    • Stormraider's lanes: a different trade. Dump as much damage as possible to proc it, even using E to get in, then use the move speed to get out before they trade back. Repeat every time your cooldowns are up. You can play much more aggressively and get away with E starts, especially when their Bone Plating is down.
    02

    Push and roam

    • Shove, then move. Push the wave in and look for plays mid or in the river.
    • Slow push before you back so you lose nothing while shopping.
    • Crash for plates once you have Sheen, since Q2 true damage burns turrets fast.
    • Proxy with Hydra. Rushing Ravenous Hydra lets you proxy and play near their tower, then sustain back up off the wave.
    • Hold it in bad lanes. Keep the wave near your tower and farm with Q until you can shove.
    03

    The vision game

    • Leave your side lane. Disappear from vision: just the threat that you might show up mid pressures their whole team.
    • Group for objectives. Be with your team before Baron or Dragon soul.
    04

    Teamfight role

    • Assassin-diver: E from fog onto their carry, then R to cut off peel.
    • R to isolate. It knocks back everyone else, so use it to cut the target off rather than as damage.
    • Wait for their CC. Let key crowd control (displacements, stuns) go out before you commit.
    • Flank. E in from an angle; E-ing in from the front gets you peeled.
